user.title: Jaguar Land Rover InControl
user.description: Sign in with your Land Rover Remote / InControl account. JLR will email you a verification code to finish, so have your inbox open — the code expires quickly.

code.title: Enter your verification code
code.description:
JLR has emailed a code to {email}. Enter it here to finish signing in.

The code expires quickly, so enter it as soon as it arrives — if the sign-in session times out you'll be asked for your password again.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Jaguar Land Rover again
reauth_confirm.description: The saved sign-in for {email} has expired. Enter your password and JLR will email a new verification code.

reconfigure.title: Sign in again
reconfigure.description:
Signing in again for {email}. This keeps your existing entities, history and automations — nothing is removed.

It also refreshes the session used to read your vehicle's location and name, which cannot be renewed automatically. Jaguar Land Rover will email you a verification code, so have your inbox open.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Jaguar Land Rover servers.
error.invalid_code: That verification code was not accepted. Check the email and try again.
error.unsupported_journey: JLR's sign-in did not follow the expected steps for this account. Please open an issue on GitHub with the details.
error.session_expired: Your sign-in session with JLR expired before the code was accepted — the window is short. Enter your password again and JLR will send a new code; have your email open before you submit.
error.api_rejected: Signed in successfully, but Jaguar Land Rover then refused the connection. Check the logs for the reason and please report it.
error.cannot_reach_api: Signed in successfully, but Home Assistant could not reach Jaguar Land Rover's vehicle servers — this looks like a DNS or network problem on your side rather than a problem with your account. Check that your DNS can resolve jlrmotor.com, including any Pi-hole, AdGuard or router-level filtering.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up. If you can't see it, the existing entry may be disabled — go to Settings → Devices & Services, find Jaguar Land Rover InControl and enable it (it will then ask you to sign in again). Delete the existing entry first if you'd rather start fresh.
abort.unknown_entry: That integration entry no longer exists.

refresh_failed.message: Could not refresh from Jaguar Land Rover. Live vehicle status is unaffected — it arrives on its own — but the vehicle list and the parked location could not be re-read just now. This is usually temporary; the next scheduled refresh will try again.

no_telemetry.message: Signed in to Jaguar Land Rover, but no vehicle data arrived over the telemetry connection within {seconds} seconds. Home Assistant will keep retrying.

auth_failed.message: Jaguar Land Rover refused the stored sign-in ({error}). You will need to sign in again, with a fresh verification code.

portal_signed_out.title: Sign in again to restore vehicle location
portal_signed_out.description:
Jaguar Land Rover's sign-in session has expired. Live vehicle status is unaffected and keeps working, but location and vehicle names cannot be refreshed until you sign in again — and the location is reported as unknown rather than showing a position that may be out of date.

Go to the Jaguar Land Rover InControl entry, open the menu on it and choose **Reconfigure**, then enter your password and the code JLR emails you. Your entities, history and automations are kept.
